title: [Master]-Reverse Production Entry fails when production output is posted using a non-base Unit of Measure.
summary: Reversing a production entry no longer fails when the production output was posted using a non-base unit of measure. The fix is in the Undo Prod. Posting Mgmt. codeunit.
